articles.headline: Huntsville school leaders address safety concerns after several guns found on campuses throughout Madison Co.
articles.excerpt: Huntsville City Schools leaders held a public safety briefing May 6 after five firearms turned up on Madison County campuses in less than two months. The district is fast-tracking weapon-detection rollout and reinforcing zero-tolerance discipline for students who bring guns to class.

articles.headline: Multiple Kansas schools targeted by statewide swatting incident, police say
articles.image_alt: Kansas police vehicles outside a school
articles.excerpt: Schools in Parsons, Chanute, Humboldt, Fort Scott, Russell and Woodson districts were forced into lockdown May 6 by AI-generated swatting calls. KBI investigators say the calls trace to a foreign criminal enterprise targeting U.S. schools to terrorize students and staff.

articles.headline: Pima County student allegedly threatened to bring gun, bomb to school
articles.image_alt: Walden Grove High School in Sahuarita, Arizona
articles.excerpt: A Walden Grove High School student in Sahuarita, Arizona was arrested Saturday after allegedly threatening to bring a gun and bomb to school Monday to hurt others. Pima County deputies booked the juvenile on threats and intimidation charges.

articles.headline: North Haven middle school, high school placed on lockdown as police investigate threat
articles.image_alt: North Haven High School in Connecticut
articles.excerpt: North Haven High School and Middle School were placed on lockdown Tuesday afternoon after police received a threat of violence directed at the high school. North Haven officers are investigating; no actual violence has occurred and students were held in classrooms while law enforcement secured the campus.

articles.headline: PSEA president urges Pa. House committee to pass legislation strengthening protections for educators injured as a result of student behavior
articles.excerpt: PSEA president Aaron Chapin testified before the Pa. House Education Committee on May 5 in support of legislation expanding paid recovery leave, workers' compensation, and removal authority for teachers injured by student violence. Educator assault reports have climbed sharply in the state.

articles.headline: Humble ISD student accused of bringing gun to campus; parents question school response
articles.image_alt: Ross Sterling Middle School in Humble, Texas
articles.excerpt: A Ross Sterling Middle School seventh-grader allegedly brought a loaded handgun to campus Friday and pointed it at three other students before classmates reported it. Police recovered the gun via search warrant; parents say Humble ISD took nearly 48 hours to alert families.

articles.headline: Bond granted for student arrested after loaded gun found on Richland County school bus
articles.image_alt: Blythewood High School in Richland County, South Carolina
articles.excerpt: An 18-year-old was arrested Monday after another student texted 911 to report a gun on a Blythewood High School bus. Richland County deputies recovered a loaded handgun and charged the suspect as an adult with carrying a weapon onto school property; he later received bond.

articles.headline: Student resource officers confiscate handguns, alcohol, and marijuana at Tennessee proms
articles.image_alt: Rutherford County school resource officers on duty
articles.excerpt: Rutherford County school resource officers recovered two loaded handguns from cars at Tennessee high school proms last weekend, alongside alcohol, marijuana and other contraband. The sheriff credited proactive parking-lot screening for keeping firearms off dance floors.

articles.headline: Teen charged in connection with Forest View Educational Center school resource officer's missing gun
articles.image_alt: Forest View Educational Center in Arlington Heights, Illinois
articles.excerpt: A 17-year-old was charged with stealing an Arlington Heights school resource officer's loaded service weapon at Forest View Educational Center on May 4. Cook County prosecutors filed felony counts; the SRO has been placed on administrative leave pending an internal affairs review.

articles.headline: Boy, 16, charged for stabbing at Foss High School that injured 4 students, security guard
articles.image_alt: Foss High School in Tacoma, Washington
articles.excerpt: A 16-year-old has been charged as an adult with four counts of first-degree assault after a mass stabbing at Foss High School in Tacoma on April 30. Four students were wounded along with a school security guard who tried to intervene; one victim required emergency surgery.

archive.headline: 6 guns, 3D printer, ammunition found at houses of high schoolers who brought guns to school
archive.image_alt: St. Charles High School in Waldorf, Maryland
archive.excerpt: Two St. Charles High School students were arrested in late April after school resource officers found loaded ghost guns on campus, one with a machine-gun conversion switch. Follow-up search warrants at the students' homes recovered six more firearms, ammunition and a 3D printer.

archive.headline: Former student armed with gun sparks havoc at Central Florida high school
archive.image_alt: Central Florida high school exterior with police response
archive.excerpt: A former student carrying a firearm entered a Central Florida high school on April 29, prompting an emergency response and lockdown. Deputies detained the suspect on campus; no shots were fired and no students were injured before officers secured the scene.

archive.headline: Teen arrested after bringing stolen gun to Nashville high school
archive.image_alt: Stratford High School in Nashville, Tennessee
archive.excerpt: A 17-year-old Stratford High School student was arrested April 29 after the campus Evolv weapon-detection system flagged a stolen handgun in his backpack at the entrance. He faces theft of a firearm and possession of a firearm on school property charges.

archive.headline: Hillsboro student taken into custody after being found with gun
archive.image_alt: Hillsboro High School in Jefferson County, Missouri
archive.excerpt: A Hillsboro High School student was taken into custody April 29 after staff found an unloaded handgun and ammunition on him during a search prompted by a tip. Jefferson County deputies took the student into custody without incident; classes continued.

archive.headline: Report of possible weapon on campus leads to lockdown at Halifax County High School
archive.image_alt: Halifax County High School in Virginia
archive.excerpt: Halifax County High School in Virginia was placed on lockdown April 28 after administrators were alerted to a possible weapon on campus. A search recovered a look-alike item rather than a functional firearm; the lockdown was lifted later that afternoon.

archive.headline: Sierra HS student arrested after allegedly threatening peer with loaded gun in school bathroom
archive.image_alt: Sierra High School in Colorado Springs
archive.excerpt: A Sierra High School student was arrested April 27 after a school resource officer responding to a bathroom disturbance found a loaded .380 handgun in the student's waistband. Police say the weapon was used to threaten another student but never discharged.

archive.headline: Painesville Riverside High School student arrested after being found with gun in school, officials say
archive.image_alt: Riverside High School in Painesville, Ohio
archive.excerpt: A Riverside High School student was arrested April 24 after administrators received a tip about a threatening image posted to social media from inside the school. Lake County deputies found the student in a classroom with a firearm. The lockdown was lifted within 22 minutes; no one was injured.

archive.headline: Swansea parents arraigned after second-grader allegedly brought gun to school
archive.image_alt: Fall River District Court, Massachusetts
archive.excerpt: Christopher and Heather Spangler of Swansea were each arraigned Wednesday on 13 firearm and child-endangerment charges after police say their second-grader brought a handgun to Hoyle Elementary School in his backpack. Both pleaded not guilty and were ordered to surrender all firearms.

archive.headline: Three MLK High School students charged with battery after fighting teacher
archive.image_alt: Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. High School entrance sign
archive.excerpt: Three students at Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. High School in DeKalb County, Georgia were charged with battery and disrupting public school after a hallway fight with a veteran teacher on April 22. Video of the incident circulated widely on social media and is being used by district investigators.

archive.headline: AI phone call prompts lockdown at South Sioux City High School, police say
archive.image_alt: South Sioux City High School exterior
archive.excerpt: An AI-generated phone call claiming a pipe bomb in the building and a shotgun on campus triggered a lockdown at South Sioux City High School on April 22. Police, sheriff's deputies, and Nebraska State Patrol cleared the school within an hour. No threat was found.

archive.headline: Student arrested at Righetti High School with loaded handgun, second such arrest this school year
archive.image_alt: Righetti High School campus in Santa Maria
archive.excerpt: An 18-year-old student was arrested at Righetti High School in Santa Maria on April 22 after a school resource deputy serving an unrelated warrant discovered a loaded handgun in his possession. He was booked on felony possession of a firearm on school grounds.

archive.headline: Grissom High School student arrested with weapon at school
archive.image_alt: Grissom High School in Huntsville, Alabama
archive.excerpt: A Grissom High School student was arrested April 21 after the campus weapon-detection system flagged a firearm at the entrance. Huntsville City Schools said the system worked as intended and no one was injured; the student was transported by Huntsville Police.

archive.headline: Dozens of first responders flood Valley Forge High School in Parma Heights
archive.image_alt: Valley Forge High School in Parma Heights, Ohio
archive.excerpt: Dozens of first responders converged on Valley Forge High School in Parma Heights, Ohio on April 20 after reports of a shooting in a cafeteria area. Authorities later said a juvenile was injured and the scene was secured; investigators are reviewing surveillance video.

archive.headline: SC teachers report concussions, bite marks and worse. A bill would give them more power in class.
archive.image_alt: South Carolina classroom
archive.excerpt: South Carolina H.5483 — the Educator Safety and Classroom Authority Act — would let teachers remove disruptive students, authorize reasonable force in self-defense, and bar administrators from deleting referrals. Educators reporting concussions and bite marks say it's overdue.

archive.headline: Oklahoma principal shot in leg is praised for tackling school shooter: 'He is a hero'
archive.image_alt: Pauls Valley High School Principal Kirk Moore
archive.excerpt: Principal Kirk Moore tackled a 20-year-old gunman at Pauls Valley High School on April 7, disarming him with the help of an assistant principal. Moore was shot in the leg during the struggle but held the suspect until police arrived.

archive.headline: Student violence causes SC teachers to quit. Legislators are working on a solution.
archive.image_alt: South Carolina State House
archive.excerpt: South Carolina educators are leaving the profession over escalating student violence, with reports of concussions, torn tendons, and one miscarriage caused by student assaults. A House bill to remove repeatedly violent students stalled in committee over equity concerns.

archive.headline: Protecting teachers from workplace violence as student behavior challenges rise
archive.image_alt: Teacher in a classroom representing workplace safety concerns
archive.excerpt: Educator-victimization rates are climbing, and schools are experimenting with safety committees, response protocols and panic-alarm hardware. The piece argues districts must treat assaults on educators as workplace-violence incidents that demand a formal employer response.

archive.headline: Multiple lockdowns at Triangle schools reflect increase in threats to schools nationwide
archive.image_alt: Police vehicles outside a Triangle area school
archive.excerpt: Triangle-area schools have been on lockdown nearly every school day this week as bomb and weapon threats roll in. While North Carolina hoax-threat data dipped from 2023-24 to 2024-25, administrators warn the operational toll on staff and students is mounting.

archive.headline: $20K bond set for Splendora High School teacher accused of hoax attack by student
archive.image_alt: Splendora High School in Montgomery County, Texas
archive.excerpt: A Splendora High School teacher was charged with felony tampering and filing a false report after police say she cut herself and blamed a student for the injuries. The hoax briefly placed the campus on a secure-hold while officers investigated.

archive.headline: Bill advances to protect teachers, but critics warn of impact on students of color and rural parishes
archive.image_alt: Louisiana State Capitol Building
archive.excerpt: Louisiana House Bill 283 — the Teacher Shield Act — cleared the House on April 8 and is now under Senate review. The bill would require immediate removal and alternative placement for students who assault teachers, plus expanded leave for educator recovery.

archive.headline: Capitol Access Minute: Legislation to attract aerospace industry advances along with Teacher Shield Act
archive.image_alt: Louisiana State Capitol Building in Baton Rouge
archive.excerpt: The Teacher Shield Act passed the Louisiana House April 8 and moves to the Senate, alongside legislation incentivizing aerospace industry growth. The bill would mandate immediate removal of students who assault teachers and protect educators on injury leave.
